name: Astrid Halvorsen
bio:
Astrid's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, initially fueled by a fascination with aircraft simulators during her engineering studies at NTNU. She quickly realized the potential of simulation technology to revolutionize driver training and vehicle development. After graduation, she honed her skills at Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace, working on advanced simulation systems for military applications. However, the allure of speed and competition proved too strong to resist, leading her to Ipiranga Racing a decade ago.

Astrid's approach to simulator engineering is meticulous and data-driven. She believes in creating realistic virtual environments that accurately reflect real-world track conditions, allowing drivers to push their limits safely and effectively. Her relentless pursuit of accuracy and her ability to translate complex technical data into practical driver feedback have earned her the respect of the entire team. She is known for her direct communication style and unwavering commitment to improving performance through rigorous testing and analysis.

What sets Astrid apart is her ability to combine technical expertise with a deep understanding of driver psychology. She doesn't just focus on the technical aspects of the simulator; she also works closely with the drivers to tailor the experience to their individual needs and preferences. This holistic approach has made her an invaluable asset to Ipiranga Racing, consistently contributing to improved lap times and race results.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, naturally wavy, often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Astrid is of average height with a strong, focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Insists on absolute silence during simulator sessions, even from the drivers.
Drinks copious amounts of black coffee throughout the day, refusing anything with milk or sugar.
